text: Blind re-rule check (D3c): the sample of 50 (out/_analysis/d3c_blind/sample-D3c.json; populations A 31,211 and B 21,376 lines; 46 drawn by seed 2026102310, 4 forced) was read through d3c_blind_packet.py (packet-D3c.txt), which shows no ruling of mine, with one quote read through cite.py (jerma985/c0031). The 50 blind rulings were written to out/_analysis/d3c_blind/blind-rulings-D3c.jsonl (50 lines) before any comparison. Next: the pairs by d3c_blind_pairs.py.

Blind re-rule check, pairs (out/_analysis/d3c_blind/blind-pairs-D3c.jsonl, by d3c_blind_pairs.py; the kappa is the handler's). Raw agreement over the 46 drawn pairs: decision 42, decision and kind 35. Over the 4 forced: decision 4, decision and kind 2. All 50: 46 and 37. Of the 11 drawn differences, none is an error. In each the original applies a written clause or a quote that the blind ruling did not recall or read the other way: A02's G33 clause (a call that names a start already made), G16 and G39 on early marking (canada-047), A05's mechanism read from the other side (buffalobills-039), P10 for building again after a move (seahawks-042, whose loss the blind packet did not show), G43's layout-only clause (animalcrossing), and whether a told keeper (pebble), a one-sided judgment of covering (epublica), a newcomer's ban (tagpro), a pact's terms (eagles) or strain (lsu) shows the element. The pattern of D3a-10 recurs: add-condition, add-step and restrict lines move between specification, elaboration, limit and particular, and instantiate and absent lines hold (16 of 17 instantiate and both absent pairs agree). Two forced lines are errors under rule 13 and are fixed by appended re-rulings in out/_analysis/d3_rulings/re-rule-d3c-blind-errors.jsonl. anaheimducks-066 goes from a specification to an evidence limit, since G20, written before P09's lines were ruled, makes an attack call after hour 73 an evidence limit, and its re-check twin R-anaheimducks-93aab7cd6876-077 rules it so. neu-057 goes from a paired elaboration to a specification naming P02's 'signs it', since G4a was applied backwards to link lines (QD3-004) and its sibling neu-052 was re-ruled so, and this line was missed. hatsune-025 and slovenia-029 agree with their originals. The inconsistency the notes named between slovenia-029 (a specification) and slovenia-060 (a limit) on one P13 act stays, reported for D4, since slovenia-060 was not in the sample and was not read here.

The close-check (validate.py D3 at D3c, out/_analysis/d3c_validate_D3_01.txt) gave 5 errors. Two name files not yet written (exception-report-D.md, handback-D3.md). Three name groups of corrections met twice with no history.jsonl line citing them (listed by a new read-only script, out/_analysis/d3c_met_twice.py). (a) A21 at T4-006 (katawashoujo-051, newzealand-057) and (b) A21 at T4-014 (adventuretime-051, dallasstars-029, masseffect-056, and the re-check repeat R-adventuretime-4c65638d5e28-066). These are first-return corrections. Move 176's bound line, history line 145, records the re-examination of all 36 accepted A21 corrections (families F1 and F2, 26 and 10), and the script finds exactly 36. But its adaptations list names 22 ids, only 11 of them corrections, so 25 of the 36 are uncited. The fix is a history correction, an appended line that names the 25 beside line 145's 22 ids, with corrects_lines [145]. Line 145 stays, and A21 is unchanged. (c) P05 at T4-006 (polska, satania). The fix is a history line, dated D3c, that records section 2's re-examination with every room back and the scope decision under QD3-011's option (b): the cluster branch with a bound, carried in F-024, the revision held for D4, no field changed. It cites all 9 rooms' lines, including halo and bangtan, whose group the check passes only through portugal-029. Both lines name 'developing working hypotheses', since they carry the branch and the held revision as working hypotheses to D4. Neither changes the model hash, since history.jsonl is not a model file.

move 197 (developing working hypotheses): P05's added clause, re-examined with every room back (section 2, met twice: polska and satania at T4-006, halo and bangtan at T3-170 and T4-019), takes a scope decision without a change to the frozen model (QD3-011, option b). The frozen clause is the trunk, bounded to rooms where the keepers can learn of a planned change only by being told and no informed member holds it. Exception report rule (D3c), written before the script runs. exception-report-D.md is built by a script, out/_analysis/d3c_exception_report2.py (it supersedes d3c_exception_report.py, an unrun draft that counted shared changes within one ledger only). Classes by the last ruling: shared = accepted specification, paired elaboration or correction; accepted proposals apart; limit = accepted with kind none; particulars, NONPORTABLE counted apart; rejected; pending. A distinct shared change (prior.md section 3) is a group of accepted elaborations and corrections that D3 joined through their pairs on one element, across both ledgers, met in two rooms or more; a specification restates a standing statement and is no change. The top elements are read as prior.md section 8's spine: R01, P01, P03, P05 and the arrows A02, A01, A03. The curve is over a seeded order of the 705 rooms (seed 2026102410). The all-particular rooms are found as the close-check finds them. The local status and the labelers' grade are read from rooms/<sub>/model-D-recheck.md. Verdicts are reported by version.

Wrote out/exception-report-D.md (874 lines) by out/_analysis/d3c_exception_report2.py, seed 2026102410. Particulars are 2.8% of the re-check's 53,493 lines (699 and 814 NONPORTABLE); 525 of 705 rooms carry one; 127 of 705 (18.0%) carry one on a top element (the spine). Distinct shared changes: 499 pair-joined groups over 2,368 lines, 267 of them met in two rooms. The curve over the seeded order adds 122, 183 and 194 by third, against 123, 190 and 186 expected for these group sizes over random orders: it does not flatten, which prior.md names a sign of unbounded revision; the pairs join two lines at a time, so the group count can exceed the distinct changes, and D4's keys may merge them. No room has all its adaptations particulars. The 19 groups of corrections met twice are all cited in history. Local status: unresolved in 705 rooms, the labelers' grade composes-with-residue in 705, in both the returns index and the accounts. The D3b notes line giving 691, 4 and 10 is not reproduced by either source and is corrected in the D3c section.

uncomposed-D.md: appended 'The re-check (D3c, 2026-10-24)'. picturegame's re-check readers both give composes-with-residue under 46384686 (restated under K01, P23 and P24; residue its sound round, emoji proposals and picture hint); 72 re-check lines, all ruled (K01 3 accepted, P13 2, 3 propose particulars outside scope, 64 absent of which 63 limits). The first-return verdict stays does-not-compose, kind out-of-scope (e15f9647); no room does-not-compose at the re-check. validate.py prints the kind as outside-the-model because it takes the first of the three names the block contains, and the block names outside-the-model to say the room is not of that kind; reported, the block not changed to suit it. (Two Edits to this file ran in one turn, against the rule; both landed on separate strings.)

notes-D3.md: appended 'D3c: the freeze, the re-read and the close': J's answers; how option (b) meets the stage's line on exceptions (a scope decision made as a bounded trunk, a cluster branch and a second limit, each a condition; recorded where the claim travels; the frozen words are the re-checked words), with what stays (P05's own words are universal in form, so if J requires the element's words to carry the scope, (b) does not meet the line); move 197; history line 171; the blind check; the items held at the freeze; the field's entries at the re-check; 'Re-read against the amendments', one line per move 172 to 197 and the ruling rules; the relift; a correction to the D3b grade line; the counts, last, by version.
